name: feature.entities.nodes
description: Entities feature node pack (ADR 0386 Phase 6) — read/query/write user-defined content types over ctx.features.entities. Tenant-guarded; creates are idempotent via deterministic entity:<runId>:<nodeId> ids (ADR 0162). 'On entity written' automation rides host-event bindings (host.entities.entity.written), not a pack trigger node.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Entities Types Read
nodes.description: Lists the workspace's entity types, or one type's full field schema by typeName, over ctx.features.entities. Read-only.

nodes.label: Entities Query
nodes.description: Queries records of a type with typed filters (eq/neq/in/gt/gte/lt/lte/contains), sort and limit, over ctx.features.entities. Optional locale resolves localized values (exact -> family -> base, ADR 0406). Read-only.

nodes.label: Entities Get
nodes.description: Reads one record by typeName + entityId over ctx.features.entities. Optional locale resolves localized values (ADR 0406). Read-only.

nodes.label: Entities Create
nodes.description: Creates a record of a type through closed-world validation. Idempotent: an explicit entityId wins, else the deterministic entity:<runId>:<nodeId> id makes re-runs/forks safe (ADR 0162).

nodes.label: Entities Update
nodes.description: Patches a record's values (provided keys replace; null clears a non-required key) through closed-world validation. Update-only — replay/fork safe.

nodes.label: Entities Delete
nodes.description: Deletes a record by typeName + entityId. Relationship onDelete policies are enforced fail-closed (restrict default).
